entities.summary: Ka’dar Chaz Hollman is an American professional football cornerback. He played college football for the Toledo Rockets. He was selected in the sixth round of the 2019 NFL draft to the Green Bay Packers. He also played for the New Orleans Saints, New York Giants, San Francisco 49ers, Miami Dolphins, and Atlanta Falcons.
